definitions.explanation: Having a timid, hesitant disposition. Describes someone who lacks assertiveness or is easily discouraged.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{気弱|きよわ}な{性格|せいかく}だ。
{気弱|きよわ}になってはいけない。
{病気|びょうき}になると{気弱|きよわ}になって、すぐ{不安|ふあん}になってしまう。
examples.english: When I get sick, I become faint-hearted and quickly get anxious.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a な-adjective ({気弱|きよわ}な) and in the pattern {気弱|きよわ}になる (to become timid/discouraged). Contrasts with {気強|きづよ}い (strong-willed). Often describes a temporary state of feeling discouraged rather than a permanent character trait.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気弱|きよわ}な{人|ひと} (a timid person)
- {気弱|きよわ}になる (to become faint-hearted)
- {気弱|きよわ}な{発言|はつげん} (a weak-hearted remark)
